literal_meaning: অস্থির বা টলমলে চলার শব্দানুকরণ (toddling or staggering walk)
figurative_meaning_en: Past childhood; slightly older in age
example_sentences_in_bangla: ডাগর-ডোগর হয়েছিস, এখন এত ভয় কিসের?
সে ডাগর-ডোগর বয়সে পৌঁছে গেছে, এখন স্বাধীনভাবে খেলতে পারে।
example_sentences_in_english: You've become dagar-dogor; why so much fear now?
He has reached the dagar-dogor age, now he can play independently.
note: Refers to the unsteady gait of toddlers, symbolizing early childhood development in Bengali folk expressions.
